:::writing{variant="email" id="59302" subject="Looking forward to tomorrow’s conversation"}
Hi Ebony & Marketa,

I wanted to send a quick note ahead of our call tomorrow to say how excited I am to connect with both of you.

Ebony, I’ve been thinking a lot about our conversation and everything you shared. You’ve built something incredibly strong, especially on the front end with your client demand, conversions, and high-ticket treatments. It’s very clear the opportunity isn’t in getting more leads, it’s in strengthening the backend so you can fully capture and expand the revenue that’s already there fileciteturn0file0.

Marketa, I’m really looking forward to meeting you and diving into your side of things as well, especially around ads and operations. Ebony mentioned a few key areas she wanted to make sure we walk through together, including:

- Building out **retention systems** so clients come back consistently for skincare, facials, IVs, and ongoing treatments  
- Creating **membership programs** that generate recurring monthly revenue  
- Structuring **packages and offers** (including combining treatments, not just single-service packages)  
- Improving **follow-up systems and automation** so nothing slips through the cracks  
- Strengthening **sales and consultation structure** so the team knows exactly how to guide clients into the right long-term plans  
- Ensuring everything is set up properly for the **new location launch** so you open with momentum  

Also worth mentioning, as Ebony brought up, we handle all of this in-house. You don’t need to piece together multiple companies for packages, systems, or strategy. We build and implement it with you end-to-end.

The timing of this with your move is honestly ideal, and I’m excited to walk through how we can help you not only transition smoothly, but come into the new space with a much stronger, more scalable foundation.

Looking forward to speaking with you both tomorrow.

Bethany
:::

If you want it a little more punchy or more luxury-toned, I can tighten it up.
